review.official:
An ordinary student from
Higashi
who came to study in
Lungmen
, Utage contracted
Oripathy
after getting pulled into an incident with
Infected
persons. After coming to
Rhodes Island
per physician's advice, Utage passed the evaluation to become an
Operator
.
She is level-headed in her view of Oripathy, living life largely the same as before she became Infected. However, when she is working, she exhibits a terrifying demeanor.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal blurry outlines of this operator's internal organs, clouded with abnormal dark spots. Her circulatory system shows an abnormally high rate of Originium particulate matter, with other signs of Oripathy infection, we can confirm that the Operator is Infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Operator Utage is Infected, but has no external signs of infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.18u/L
Operator Utage rarely comes in contact with Originium. Please maintain that situation.

This exchange student from Higashi loves to eat, chases the latest fashion trends, and likes to have a good time. After contracting Oripathy after getting caught up in an incident, she came to Rhodes Island in accordance with her physician's advice. At first, a non-combat role was planned for her based upon her complete lack of combat experience, but during the evaluation, she demonstrated a considerable talent for fighting. After some discussion, the examiner decided to let her participate in some field missions. Of course, the bulk of her work will still be non-combat related, such as logistics or HR work more suitable for someone her age.

Utage revels in the challenge of new things. As fashion is constantly shifting and lines up with her interests, she naturally pays more attention to these things. Over time, she has become a bit of an authority. What company is gearing up to release a new product, and how does its prospects on the market look? She always has her finger on the pulse of new information, and is ready to share it with any nearby Operators who are interested. Thanks to her, the average fashionability of the Operators here has improved greatly, but their wallets have been proportionally flattened.

I must note that Utage is very good at disguising and manipulating her mental state. As a result, conventional psychological monitoring methods are not reliable in her case. In addition to her strong psychological qualities, I also believe that her race has something to do with the phenomenon. The other Operators from Higashi have no insights as to her race, and unless she decides to disclose this information herself, we might have to commit a lot of effort into this question... Wait, you mean, her blade? Hmm.... perhaps there is a lot we can learn from her blade. This line of tracking may well be more successful than other alternatives. Understood, I'll get in touch with Vulcan. Once I have the information, I'll enter it into the database and make it available to you.

'You're back? Did you get it done? I see. Still couldn't find anything, huh? Guess that's not unexpected... Hey, s-stop hitting me, it's my bad, so stop already!'
'I know you had good intentions and wanted the Doctor to get to know each Operator better. However, everyone has their own secrets, right? For example, you wouldn't want everyone to find out right now that you're planning to propose to your girlfriend and have an engagement ring in a compartment in your desk. Oh, how'd I find out? Well, uh, ahahaha.'
'What's important is not to air out every nitty gritty detail about an Operator's life, but rather to determine whether or not they are trustworthy, and assign them accordingly. That's already enough. Utage deserves the Doctor's trust, as well as ours, but she may never decide to trust us with her secrets. As for the Doctor, perhaps she will eventually open up, given the right time and place.

[Excerpts from an Encrypted Channel - Regarding Utage] 
'If you want to know what's 'in' with the chicks, then you've come to the right place.'
'She's really good at creating a laid-back atmosphere.'

'She always has her finger on the pulse. Whenever something limited edition hits the market, she's on top of it right away. Being able to strike a business deal was super lucky.'

'D-did she just give me an evil eye? I could feel shivers going down my spine...'

'I can't figure out what that kid is thinking.'

'When she smiles like that, yes, those vibes, now that's a bit interesting.'

'That's just me faking it~ I don't mind teach you if you want to learn.'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are you ready to work? I won't take no for an answer. C'mon. 3, 2, 1, start.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take good care of them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. It means 'Party' in Higashinese, and I just wanna live my life like it's a party every night. If I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad. Now the only way out is for you… is to come with me and use this two-for-one coupon.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: When I got Oripathy and started talking about coming here, my mom was worried about bullying. So she gave me the family heirloom, Shishiou, to defend myself. Didn't find any bullies, but I did manage to cut up some pretty bad guys. Doctor, you really know how to treat a girl.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The people here turn all scary when they get serious. I'm as scary as six of them put together? Really…? Am I that terrifying?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doc. Help me pick up ten boxes of limited-edition cookie sticks tomorrow? Just give me an advance on my pay. What? I've advanced the whole thing already? Aww c'mon, there's gotta be something you can do. Please, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, you're razor-sharp some of the time and dull as a block at others. I don't get why. Oh, I see, right out of that 'How to Talk to Girls' book, huh? I'd expect nothing less from you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It's not good to rely too much on any one person, but maybe the Doctor is an... Eek, Doctor! Oh it's nothing, I was just rambling to myself! D-D-Did you need something from me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: If you're tired, just go to bed. Not that complicated.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. I'm your new operator, Utage. My hobbies are... Oh, I don't need to go into the details? Alright then, I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is it over?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Do I get work less after I get promoted? No dice? Oh well…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I guess it's time for me to get serious. Alright, let's crush the bad guys!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Alright, everyone, I'll be counting on your orders!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hmm, team captain… Eh? Me? Captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: C'mon, c'mon! I can't wait any longer.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeees?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Moving out!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who should I cut?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: It won't hurt if I don't miss.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll take what you don't need.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You look kinda cute when you cry.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ahh, it felt good to blow off all that steam. Exciting stuff. Let's go for crepes, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was so much fun. Thanks for all the enemies!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You're saving the stragglers for me? Well, I'll dig right in.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: C'mon, Doctor, stop spacing out and start running.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: As long as I can get my magazines, it doesn't really matter where I stay.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna go sing karaoke?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. Happy New Year! As you can see, I'm trapped under this kotatsu... Hang with me for a bit maybe? It's waaarm. C'mon, just try it, you won't regret it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Did you know? There's a real trick to birthday parties. I could share some hacks with you, like, on the down-low, to really up your popularity at dinnertime. Number one—wait, are these all your presents?! This whole room?!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The dinner party today was, like, killer. That's the kind of thing you should really do every day. Otherwise, you start overthinking things and get all hung up on it. Then stuff gets worse and lose all your optimism for life, which is tough to hold onto. Meh, that's just me babbling to myself, don't worry about it. Anyway, enjoy the happiness you've got in the moment, that's what matters most!
